name: Path portability guard
summary: Block new repository paths that are invalid or collision-prone across common filesystems.
description: A deterministic Claude Code PreToolUse gate for Write, Edit, and MultiEdit that rejects Windows-reserved names, forbidden characters, trailing dots or spaces, control bytes, and case-fold collisions with existing siblings.
refuses: It does not rename, move, delete, normalize, transliterate, or create a requested path.
It does not guarantee portability to every filesystem, archive format, or deployment target.
It does not follow project-defined ignore files or inline exceptions authored by the agent.
It does not inspect file content or infer whether a portability issue is intentional.

entrypoints.purpose: Validate proposed repository paths for cross-platform filename safety and sibling case-fold collisions.
